## 🎉🎉 ASIMOV Group Opening Convoy 🎉🎉
## 


-----


## We are excited to announce the official opening convoy of ASIMOV Group!  

### ASIMOV Group Opening Convoy 🎉🚛

The moment has arrived,  ASIMOV Group is officially rolling out We do not only want to celebrate our Validation but our Opening!

We are thrilled to announce the Opening Convoy of ASIMOV Group, a celebration of the start of our VTC journey in 2026. After already sharing some amazing drives together, it is time to turn the excitement up and mark this milestone in true convoy style.

Join us for a festival of trucks, lights, roads, and community spirit as we travel across Europe together. We invite all community members, friends, partners, and fellow drivers to be part of this special event and help us celebrate the beginning of something big.

Get ready for great routes, good vibes, and an unforgettable evening on the road as we continue building the future of ASIMOV Group together. ✨🚛🔥


-----



## 
## 📅 Date: 25th September 2026  
## 🕕 Meet-up: 17:00 UTC  
## 🕖 Departure: 18:00 UTC  
## 📍 Start Location: Cologne & Düsseldorf (Slots)  
## 🏁 Destination: Bern (SellPlan)  
## 📏 Distance: 1028 km  
## 📦 DLC Required: None  


[![](https://united-convoys.com/static/UC_banner_CC.png)](https://www.united-convoys.com/discord)


-----



## We hope to see many drivers joining us on the road for this special occasion. Let’s make this opening convoy a memorable one for the entire ASIMOV Group community!
event_request.rules:
Event Rules for Participants:

- The Event Staff are recognized as "UC | CC, UC | CCS, UC | ST, UC | Lead, UC | Tail, UC | MT, UC | GM" or similar.
- Impersonating Event Staff using the above-mentioned tags is forbidden.
- Advertising is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
- Overtaking is prohibited.
- Participants must haul a trailer.
- Double trailers, Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
- Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
- Participants with consistent lag must remain at the back of the convoy.
- Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.
- Participants should park at their designated slots. If you do not have a designated slot you are required to park at the 'Public Parking' slot
- Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
- Cars and Buses are prohibited except for Event Staff showing a clear tag.
- All other TruckersMP rules apply..


Event Rules for Event Staff:

- Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
- Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
- Event Staff are permitted to park out of bounds as long as it is on the ground and not on top of a building or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
- Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
- All other TruckersMP rules apply.
